description.zh: 删除实时日志投递服务域名，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The acceleration domain name for which you want to disable real-time log delivery. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,).
The name of the Logstore where log entries are stored.
The name of the Log Service project that is used for real-time log delivery.

description.zh: 实时投递sls的地域，详情请参见[实时日志投递用户Region列表](~~144883~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Log Service project is deployed. For more information, see [Regions that support real-time log delivery](~~144883~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn delete-realtime-log-delivery --domain example.com --project ProjectName --logstore LogstoreName --biz-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn DeleteRealtimeLogDelivery --region cn-hangzhou --Project ProjectName --Logstore LogstoreName --Region 'cn-shanghai' --Domain 'example.com'
